title: Pasting a picture on a phone

steps.path: Chat, on a phone or a phone browser: copy a picture, then paste into the message box
steps.headline: Pasting a picture into the message box now attaches it, the same as the paperclip does.
steps.changed: A picture pasted on a phone is sent up to your computer and attached above the message box. Before, nothing happened. The right-click Paste menu does the same where the phone browser allows it.
steps.notice: The picture shows as a small card with a remove button, like one added with the paperclip. Pasting words works as before.
steps.risk: The YouCoded Android app itself is unchanged, so pasting a picture there still does nothing.
